## Environment and trainer

Public project links, versions, OS, and intended task. Is this evaluation or RL?

## Current blocker

What have you tried? What fails? A small synthetic reproduction is ideal.

## Expected result

What observable result would make the integration useful? What is your timeline?

## Collaboration

Can you run tests or contribute an adapter? If not, what support would help?
Please do not assume a support SLA or committed delivery date.

> This issue is public. Do not include API keys, production screenshots,
